run_sam3_image_segmentation: run SAM3 model on an image with text prompt to produce predicted segmentation masks and bounding boxes
create_sam3_vision_encoder: create a SAM3 vision encoder that extracts multi-level FPN features and position encodings from input images
build_sam3_geometry_encoder: build a geometry encoder that encodes box prompts with direct projection, ROI pooling, and position encoding
test_sam3_detr_decoder: test the DETR-style decoder with box refinement, presence token, and relative position bias attention
review_sam3_mask_decoder: review the mask decoder that combines object queries with pixel-level features to predict instance masks and semantic segmentation
